installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Valheim Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'debian:buster-slim'
apt -y update
apt -y --no-install-recommends --no-install-suggests install wget

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} ${EXTRA_FLAGS} +quit

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

echo "-------------------------------------------------------"
echo "installing BepInEx and Selected ModPacks from Hexium..."
echo "-------------------------------------------------------"

HEXIUM_BASE="https://hexium.gg"
BEPINEX_NAMESPACE="denikson"
BEPINEX_NAME="BepInExPack_Valheim"
BEPINEX_VERSION="5.4.2350"

hexium_package_json() {
    local namespace="$1"
    local name="$2"
    local version="$3"

    curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors \
        -H "accept: application/json" \
        "${HEXIUM_BASE}/api/experimental/package/${namespace}/${name}/${version}/"
}

download_hexium_package() {
    local dependency="$1"
    local destination="$2"
    local namespace name version package_json download_url

    # Hexium dependency strings: TeamName-ModName-x.y.z
    if [[ ! "$dependency" =~ ^([^-]+)-(.+)-([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+([.-][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?)$ ]]; then
        fatal "Invalid Hexium dependency string: ${dependency}"
    fi

    namespace="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    name="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    version="${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"

    echo "Resolving ${namespace}/${name} ${version} from Hexium..."
    package_json="$(hexium_package_json "$namespace" "$name" "$version")" ||
        fatal "Could not resolve ${dependency} from Hexium"

    download_url="$(jq -er '.download_url' <<<"$package_json")" ||
        fatal "Hexium returned no download_url for ${dependency}"

    echo "Downloading ${dependency}..."
    curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors \
        -o "$destination" "$download_url" ||
        fatal "Could not download ${dependency}"
}

install_hexium_mod() {
    local dependency="$1"
    local zip_path tmp package_name
    zip_path="/tmp/${dependency}.zip"
    tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
    package_name="${dependency%-*}"

    download_hexium_package "$dependency" "$zip_path"

    unzip -q "$zip_path" -d "$tmp" ||
        fatal "Could not extract ${dependency}"

    # Preserve package layout instead of flattening DLLs. This supports plugins,
    # patchers, core, monomod, assets, and package-provided config files.
    mkdir -p "/mnt/server/BepInEx/plugins/${package_name}"

    if [ -d "$tmp/plugins" ]; then
        cp -a "$tmp/plugins/." "/mnt/server/BepInEx/plugins/${package_name}/"
    fi
    if [ -d "$tmp/patchers" ]; then
        mkdir -p "/mnt/server/BepInEx/patchers/${package_name}"
        cp -a "$tmp/patchers/." "/mnt/server/BepInEx/patchers/${package_name}/"
    fi
    if [ -d "$tmp/core" ]; then
        mkdir -p "/mnt/server/BepInEx/core/${package_name}"
        cp -a "$tmp/core/." "/mnt/server/BepInEx/core/${package_name}/"
    fi
    if [ -d "$tmp/monomod" ]; then
        mkdir -p "/mnt/server/BepInEx/monomod/${package_name}"
        cp -a "$tmp/monomod/." "/mnt/server/BepInEx/monomod/${package_name}/"
    fi
    if [ -d "$tmp/config" ]; then
        mkdir -p /mnt/server/BepInEx/config
        cp -an "$tmp/config/." /mnt/server/BepInEx/config/ || true
    fi

    # Thunderstore/Hexium packages commonly place plugin files directly at ZIP root.
    find "$tmp" -maxdepth 1 -type f \
        ! -name 'manifest.json' \
        ! -name 'README.md' \
        ! -name 'CHANGELOG.md' \
        ! -name 'icon.png' \
        -exec cp -a {} "/mnt/server/BepInEx/plugins/${package_name}/" \;

    rm -rf "$tmp" "$zip_path"
}

# Hexium assumes BepInEx for Valheim packages, so install it explicitly.
bepinex_json="$(hexium_package_json \
    "$BEPINEX_NAMESPACE" "$BEPINEX_NAME" "$BEPINEX_VERSION")" ||
    fatal "Could not retrieve BepInEx release info from Hexium"

bepinex_url="$(jq -er '.download_url' <<<"$bepinex_json")" ||
    fatal "Hexium returned no BepInEx download_url"

cd /mnt/server
curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors \
    -o "/tmp/${BEPINEX_NAMESPACE}-${BEPINEX_NAME}-${BEPINEX_VERSION}.zip" \
    "$bepinex_url" ||
    fatal "Could not download BepInEx from Hexium"

rm -rf /tmp/bepinex-install
mkdir -p /tmp/bepinex-install
unzip -q "/tmp/${BEPINEX_NAMESPACE}-${BEPINEX_NAME}-${BEPINEX_VERSION}.zip" \
    -d /tmp/bepinex-install

if [ -d /tmp/bepinex-install/BepInExPack_Valheim ]; then
    cp -a /tmp/bepinex-install/BepInExPack_Valheim/. /mnt/server/
else
    # Hexium-compatible packages may also contain the BepInEx layout directly.
    cp -a /tmp/bepinex-install/. /mnt/server/
fi

rm -rf /tmp/bepinex-install \
    "/tmp/${BEPINEX_NAMESPACE}-${BEPINEX_NAME}-${BEPINEX_VERSION}.zip"

if [ -n "${V_MODPACK:-}" ]; then
    # Resolve the exact Hexium modpack version and read its dependency list.
    if [[ ! "$V_MODPACK" =~ ^([^-]+)-(.+)-([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+([.-][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?)$ ]]; then
        fatal "Invalid Hexium ModPack dependency string: ${V_MODPACK}"
    fi

    modpack_namespace="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    modpack_name="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    modpack_version="${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"

    echo "Resolving ModPack ${V_MODPACK} from Hexium..."
    modpack_json="$(hexium_package_json \
        "$modpack_namespace" "$modpack_name" "$modpack_version")" ||
        fatal "Could not retrieve ${V_MODPACK} from Hexium"

    mapfile -t dependencies < <(jq -er '.dependencies[]?' <<<"$modpack_json") ||
        fatal "Could not read dependencies for ${V_MODPACK}"

    # Delete old mod code only after the modpack was successfully resolved.
    rm -rf /mnt/server/BepInEx/plugins/*
    rm -rf /mnt/server/BepInEx/patchers/*

    for dependency in "${dependencies[@]}"; do
        # Hexium assumes BepInEx; ignore it if an imported manifest still lists it.
        if [[ "$dependency" == *"-BepInExPack_Valheim-"* ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        install_hexium_mod "$dependency"
    done
fi

## cleanup
echo "-------------------------------------------------------"
echo "cleanup files..."
echo "-------------------------------------------------------"
rm -fR /mnt/server/BepInExPack_Valheim
rm -fR /mnt/server/icon.png
rm -fR /mnt/server/manifest.json
rm -fR /mnt/server/README.md

echo "-------------------------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed"
echo "-------------------------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name that appears in server browser.

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: Name to load if switching between multiple saved worlds.

variables.name: Backup Interval
variables.description: Change how often the world will save in seconds. Default: 1800 (30 minutes).

variables.name: Backup Count
variables.description: Sets how many automatic backups will be kept. The first is the 'short' backup length, and the rest are the 'long' backup length. When default values are used means one backup that is 2 hours old, and 3 backups that are 12 hours apart. Default: 4.

variables.name: Backup Shorttime
variables.description: Sets the interval between the first automatic backups in seconds. Default: 7200 (2 hours).

variables.name: Backup Longtime
variables.description: Sets the interval between the subsequent automatic backups in seconds. Default: 43200 (12 hours).

variables.name: [System] Console Filter
variables.description: Remove unwanted outputs from the console.

variables.name: [System] App ID
variables.description: Valheim steam app id for auto updates.
